Reference sheets and sound boards

ConversationsThe nine MVP exchanges: play each one, boy/girl voice, register, placeholder flags; simulate the first launch, Cook and the clinic. Family voice clipsMum's and Zafar's words from the recordings (Section B, then Round 3): play each one, tick the good ones. End-of-round screen and onboardingThe three badges and word review; the ghost-hand onboarding on a fake chai station. Order cardThe shared person card (person → items → parts): every state, in the sidebar and the request pop-up. Shared kit: every stateThe frame's sidebar kit on one sheet: the guide box, the order card (stacked and pills), the tally and the bulb. ?part=results or ?part=words opens the end screen.

Speaking moments ask for the microphone; if you say no, word pills appear instead. Nothing you say leaves the device.
